conclusion: Prompt v2 fixed the copied-placeholder failure and produced a perfect address/date-of-birth case, but Qwen3-0.6B failed the diagnostic quality gate because it missed PII and replaced many ordinary spans. Test Qwen3-1.7B with the unchanged prompt and fixtures before another prompt revision.
